title: Scorebug as a strip of tape: stencil codes and scores on black and ink plates, a paper centre with map and clock; reflows at half size
use: A live scorebug for a two-team best-of series over gameplay; --param scale=half reflows it for a picture-in-picture or mobile window (not a uniform shrink). Match point: --param sticker=true; technical pause: --param centre_frame=dashed with the pause copy in centre_label / centre_title / clock.

scale.note: half = the 50% reflow: every text max(12 px, size x 0.5), codes and scores drop their spray bridges

sticker.note: the ransom-note match-point sticker above team A

backdrop.note: draw the gameplay feed slot under the bug (false: a transparent overlay)

feed.note: a gameplay frame; muted slate placeholder so the overlay inks stay the loudest thing

team_a_code.note: spray-stencil lettering: A-Z, 0-9 and : . - / # ! ? (code-drawn, no font)

score_a.note: spray-stencil lettering: A-Z, 0-9 and : . - / # ! ? (code-drawn, no font)

team_b_code.note: spray-stencil lettering: A-Z, 0-9 and : . - / # ! ? (code-drawn, no font)

score_b.note: spray-stencil lettering: A-Z, 0-9 and : . - / # ! ? (code-drawn, no font)

relations: Team A prints pink, team B prints paper white, everyone else black and white: teams differ by code, not only colour.
The whole bug tilts -1.2 degrees with one hard 6 px black shadow; the sticker -4 degrees over its top-left corner.
At half scale nothing goes under 12 px and the stencil bridges go (they close up at 20 px).
decoration: Map pips, spray bridges, the dashed pause frame, the feed placeholder.

provenance.corpus: esports-broadcast case v2 (北线联赛总决赛): our own original fictional league in the xerox-flyer grammar
provenance.experiment: styles/xerox-flyer/style.json provenance; case renders in docs/cases/esports-broadcast
provenance.method: Rebuilt from the case's scorebug(state, {f}) flex layout as explicit geometry: widths come from the lettering and the text model, so the plates fit their copy; the half-scale reflow follows the case's rule (max(min size, size x f), bridges off below 0.75).
measured: Case v2: scorebug first pass 1 tool finding (a ransom scrap fell back to Barlow and lost a CJK glyph) and 3 by eye; on-air composite 5 (sticker off-canvas 3, a missing ▸ glyph 2); final 0.
50% reflow: smallest text 11 px in the case (MAP 4 · BO5); this template keeps the bank's 12 px minimum.
